{{Intro/Location|Mawburrow Desert}} The sandy expanse lies in the hinterland of Lahai-Roi and is infested with [[Voidworm|Voidworms]]. Its sole areas, the ''Voidspawn Control Complex Sectors'', are only accessible during the main quest [[What Burns Beneath Frostlands]].
